title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: The emperor responds to the division with relief, promising standards, drums, lands, and recognition to those who stand apart from Banda and help shrink his base.
He also sends pressure through commanders such as Himmat Khan, while crediting the Guru Mother’s intervention with having stripped Banda of much of his light and support.
Himmat Khan anchors the page because the policy now passes from court relief into operational pressure.
